name: Mixture of Gaussian Mixture Models (MoGMM)
definition: A non-parametric method to estimate complex, overlapping probability density functions in histogram space by fitting a mixture of GMMs, eliminating the need for a priori knowledge of the number of distributions.
summary: MoGMM is a non-parametric method for automatic transfer function generation in volume rendering that uses localized Gaussian Mixture Models to eliminate the need for prior knowledge of distribution counts.
